description: Read the whole pinned registry in one reply: every active object (fields, semantics, tokens, traits) and every trait’s full definition, keyed by name, with the recorded component mappings (none on this hosted process), a canonical etag and generatedAt. registry names the live source, the loaded names and any loader issues; includeInternal adds OODS Foundry’s internal objects, which registry.hiddenInternal counts otherwise. Use object_registry show instead for one object’s composed definition with its view extensions, and catalog_list for components. Read-only, with no side effects: it writes nothing and changes no state.

inputSchema.description: Bulk-read recorded mappings plus live shipped and registered team traits and objects. Reports definition loader issues, including shadowed names. Draft preferred_terms, disambiguation_decisions and capabilities are not snapshot outputs.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

inputSchema.title: registry.snapshot input
